text: The Ogre Warchief was the leader of a group of ogres that had claimed supplies that were previously hidden by the blood elves as their own. The Ogre Warchief and his men were eventually killed by Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider who then reclaimed the supplies.
Ogre Figurine is a common ogre archaeology artifact, created from 45 Ogre Archaeology Fragments. One Ogre Missive may be used to solve this artifact.
Olaf Blightbearer is a forsaken follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Okk is a magnaron seen during the Assault on the Dark Portal standing behind . He is never encountered or seen again.
Ogron Lifters are ogron found throughout the Iron Docks in Gorgrond.
Okuna Longtusk's Doubloon is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
Ol' Toomba is a jungle troll pirate sitting by himself on the bottom floor of the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.

Ojin'ba, chieftess of the Witherbark tribe, is a forest troll located at the entrance to the Tower of Arathor in the Arathi Highlands during the The Ruined Kingdom questline. Prince Galen wants her killed for Our Oldest Enemies.

Oil Rig Engineers are goblin engineers working at the oil platform of the Sludge Fen in Northern Barrens during the Legion Invasions. It is unknown if they work for the Venture Company normally occupying the area or the Horde-aligned Bilgewater Cartel.

Oilrig Snipers are goblins protecting the oil platform of the Sludge Fen in Northern Barrens during the Legion Invasions. It is unknown if they work for the Venture Company normally occupying the area or the Horde-aligned Bilgewater Cartel.

Oilrig Bombers are friendly goblin bombardiers protecting the oil platform of the Sludge Fen during the Legion Invasions. They are found near stacks of Shortfuse Special bombs. It is unknown if they work for the Venture Company normally occupying the area or the Horde-aligned Bilgewater Cartel.
Ol' Eary is a rare elite shark that appears at Booty Bay in Cape of Stranglethorn during Pirates' Day.

A small ogre girl belonged to the Dire Maul Gordunni clan and was a servant of King Gordok. He was constantly slapping her. When Gordok was killed in mak'gora by Malus and the rebellious slaves escaped their captors, she rushed to join them. When the escaping murlocs saw her, they allowed her to join them since they saw how Gordok treated her. She immediately helped the one-legged tauren Woolbeard up to the hill and left Dire Maul, likely to the murlocs' village in the Forgotten Coast.

The Okril'lon is a Horde group operating from the Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands after the Cataclysm. They fought against the Alliance forces of Nethergarde Keep. Their mine focus were the Nethergarde Mines. They have enslaved several ogres of the Dreadmaul tribe when the Warmatron and her forces retook the Hold. Apparently, non-orc soldiers are members but are not very welcomed in the Hold according to Rofilian Dane. Some time before the Ironmarch invasion, the Dreadmaul Hold was renamed to Okril'lon Hold. When the Iron Horde's invasion force attacked Nethergarde, Okril'lon forces marched to it but in the meantime the Ironmarch captured the Hold.
Oil Slimes are oozelings located at the Steam Pools in Feralas.
Okril'lon Infantries are orcs located in the Nethergarde Supply Camps of Blasted Lands.
Okril'lon Scouts are orcs located outside Nethergarde Keep in Blasted Lands.

Ol' Jonda is a Zandalari troll located at Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.

Oil-stained Wolves are saber worgs located in the Borean Tundra.

Ol' Stompy is a brutosaur eating from some trees on the Shrouded Shore in Vol'dun. It has the [https://www.wowhead.com/spell=280037/hungry Hungry] debuff, but it can be fed using Snake on a Stick. Feeding Ol' Stompy is a criterion of Eating Out of the Palm of My Tiny Hand.
Ogre Woundmasters are ogre warriors serving under Mug'thol of the Stonemaul clan during The Dark Lady.
Ogre War Mages are ogre magi serving under Mug'thol of the Stonemaul clan during The Dark Lady.

Ol' Bonebite is a skeletal bird of prey that spawns to accompany the player in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun while they have the Thirst for Adventure, Thirst for Brew, and Thirst for Treasure buffs active. Bonebite remains by the player's side as long as all three buffs persist. Killing 20 pirates in Zem'lan while accompanied by Bonebite rewards the Scourge of Zem'lan achievement.
Okril'lon Blood Guards were orcs set to appear in the Blasted Lands during the Iron Horde Incursion. They wore the Kor'kron tabard.
Oil Pumps were oil derricks found in the Blazing Strand in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.

Ol' Dunken is an individual of the Bloodsail Buccaneers sent by Fleet Master Firallon to scout an area in the Cape of Stranglethorn and to wait for the signal to attack Booty Bay in year 25.
__NOTOC__ Ogre Overseer is a rare ogre located at the Quilboar Briarpatch on Exile's Reach. He oversees the quilboar tribe on behalf of Gor'groth.

__NOTOC__ Ogre Shadowcasters are ogres located at Darkmaul Citadel on Exile's Reach. During Right Beneath Their Eyes, they're toward the player. Some can also be found dead at the entrance to Killclaw's Lair, where Killclaw the Terrible walks around slashing and biting at their bodies.

Okir is a centaur of Clan Shikaar who serves as the deaf Sansok Khan's interpreter in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He is always by his khan's side, acting as her speaker for those not versed in her signs and translating others' speech into sign language for her benefit. Okir is first seen alongside Sansok at Timberstep Outpost before accompanying her to Maruukai. During the battle in the Storm Scar, he accompanies his khan at the southern edge of the battlefield.

Ohn Seshteng is a centaur of Clan Ohn'ir serving as the spiritual advisor to Clan Shikaar in the Ohn'ahran Plains. She is first seen at her tent north of Timberstep Outpost as adventurers are introducing themselves to Shikaar who'll be joining the journey to the Khural at Maruukai. Seshteng is intrigued by the outsiders' arrival and says that she looks forward to learning more about them. During the caravan's journey, Seshteng hears Ohn'ahra calling to her and asks the Shikaar to stop at a river crossing, where she conducts a ritual and receives a dire omen from the Windmother. On arrival to Maruukai, Seshteng heads to the Ohn'ir pools to speak with her superior, Tigari Khan, about the omen.

The Ogre Rumour was a collection of ideas and discussions which suggested that the new Alliance race to be introduced with The Burning Crusade may be the race of Ogres. These rumours were quashed upon Blizzard's announcement that the new race would be the Draenei.

Old Serra'kis is a huge threshadon hidden mini-boss found in the Forgotten Pool in Blackfathom Deeps. After the Cataclysm, it was driven out by the Guardian of the Deep so that the monstrous crab could lay eggs in its territory.

__NOTOC__ Old Murk-Eye is a murloc that patrols the shore of Westfall, near the old Westfall Lighthouse. Captain Grayson wants Murk-Eye killed. Murk-Eye is slightly stronger than the lackeys around him. He can be seen fighting the forces of Deathwingurlugull in Azmerloth.

Old Ironbark is an Ancient of War in the east wing of Dire Maul. He aids adventurers seeking access to the deeper portions of the wing by breaking down an ancient door. Before he can break down the door, players must kill Zevrim Thornhoof.

Olsen's Farthing was once a bustling farmstead with direct contact into the main throughway of trade in the Silverpine Forest. Olsen and his family lived here and made a good living, but all that changed with the coming of the Scourge. One night, crazed ghouls and fearsome skeletal warriors charged the farm, murdering any they came across. Olsen desperately tried to barricade himself and his family inside the barn, but the undead eventually broke the barricade and proceeded to butcher the entire family. For a time the Scourge still haunted the farm, ravenously attacking anyone who enter the area. However, Olsen's Farthing has since become a battleground between the Forsaken and the remnants
Oliver Dwor is a Forsaken weapon vendor located in Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

Old Icebeard is an elite wendigo found at the end of an upper side path within the Grizzled Den in Dun Morogh. Previously he was found in a cave Chill Breeze Valley in Dun Morogh. With him was a meat locker he had stolen from Tundra MacGrann. However, Old Icebeard would periodically walk outside, leaving the cave—and the stolen meats—unguarded for a short time.
Old Vicejaw was a rare mob brown bear found roaming the area between Ambermill and Deep Elem Mine in Silverpine Forest. He was on a 1.5-2.5 hour respawn timer.
Omnicast Boots are a pair of Level 51 quality Cloth Boots that improve Intellect, Stamina and Critical Strike.

Omor the Unscarred is the second or third boss of the Hellfire Ramparts wing of the Hellfire Citadel instance in Hellfire Peninsula. You can choose whether you wish to fight him before or after Vazruden and Nazan.

__NOTOC__ Omgorn the Lost is a rare ogre found in Tanaris. He has three respawn locations, , and . One in each ogre camp.

Old Cliff Jumper is a rare timber wolf located in the Hinterlands. He possesses a unique dark greyish skin and is occasionally tamed by hunters due to his distinct look. However now The Lone Hunter shares the same skin, albeit transparent when summoned.
The om'riggor was a rite of passage in orcish society marking the transition to adulthood, taking place at the age of 12. In the modern day, it has been replaced by the om'gora.
Omor's Hoof is one quest items required to complete the Ramparts boss kill quest.

Old Hillsbrad Foothills is the setting of the instance Escape from Durnholde Keep. It is one of the timeways ("wings") accessible in the Caverns of Time. The setting takes place seven years before WoW's present (i.e. two years before the events of Warcraft III), to when the future Warchief Thrall was a slave of Aedelas Blackmoore, master of Durnholde Keep. The questing involves helping Thrall escape. The instance area in question spans from Southshore (where familiar personalities of WoW present can be found) to Tarren Mill.

Ommra was a Swedish Blizzard employee and was one of the English language Online Community Representatives for the English European World of Warcraft community. On 28th of March 2007, she attended a meeting in a London pub of various posters from the European Off Topic forum. Although she forgot to pay for her meal, she quickly apologized and returned the money that was owed. She has derived her name from legendary Egyptian actor Omar Sharif. On 7th of July 2007, Ommra announced on the Off Topic forum that she was leaving the Community Representative team citing that she was "off for new adventures and old hunting grounds".

Olemba Seeds are found in light blue Olemba Cones scattered at the foot of trees around the forested area of Terokkar Forest. The cones yield anywhere from 1-3 seeds.

__NOTOC__ Old Whitebark is the elder and the leader of the treants of Eversong Woods. In the past, he led his kind to help the blood elves in the area, and formed an alliance with them, helping them to rebuild a village. He first met Larianna Riverwind near the runestone, and she gave the treant elder a pendant. However, due to the growing threats that came from the Ghostlands to the south, the blood elves were forced to burn the forest to prevent the intrusion of the Scourge, which has caused the treants to turn against the blood elves. However, she was may have been slain as she was not amongst The Nine.

The Omnotron Defense System, also known as Tron Council and the Omnotron Council is a council-type boss encounter in Blackwing Descent. The bosses' starting positions are (from left to right if you are facing them from the entrance of the room) Magmatron, Arcanotron, Toxitron, and Electron.

as it appeared at WoW launch]] The term "old world" is used in the World of Warcraft community to denote the parts of the in-game Azeroth that have existed since vanilla WoW, before the expansions. As commonly understood, the old world does not include the Azuremyst Isles and Quel'Thalas (which were added to Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, respectively, in The Burning Crusade), nor Outland and Northrend. This term was also used internally by the developers, as seen by the filename oldworld.mpq in patch 4.0.1 and patch 4.0.3, which contains the classic versions of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms — as opposed to world.mpq, containing the versions introduced with the world update in

The Old Dormitory is the starting location of the gnomes following Operation: Gnomeregan's successful conclusion. The player starts out as an irradiated survivor who, with the help of Nevin Twistwrench and S.A.F.E., must fight their way to the surface.

Oliver Harris is a worgen quest giver located in Raven Hill in Duskwood. He is working to save the mindless worgen running rampant in the area. He is the master of Apprentice Fess. Tobias Mistmantle is another worgen in Duskwood that refers to him as "Master Harris". During the Fourth War, Vassandra Stormclaw was working in Raven Hill, and his sedative was used to drug and bring Bloodeyes to her alive.
Olivia Jayne is a draenei child wandering around Olivia's Pond in Stormwind, which seems to be named after her.

The Old Horde (aka old Horde or the first Horde; known during the time of its existence simply as the Horde, the Orcish Horde, or the Orc Horde) is a nickname given to the Horde from its beginning prior to the First War until it was defeated by the Alliance of Lordaeron at the end of the Second War. It is used to differentiate it from the New Horde, founded by Thrall after the Old Horde's defeat. Fundamental principles of the Old Horde included demon worship, the consumption of demon blood to become stronger, merciless killing and warfare, and victory in combat to prove one's worth. Their ranks consisted originally only of orcs, soon joined by ogres from Draenor and later by forest trolls an
The following NPCs can be found inside the Escape from Durnholde Keep instance.

Oltarg is an orc quest giver found at Honor's Stand in the Southern Barrens. For speaking up while another prisoner was being beaten, he was blinded by Captain Peake. Even after receiving the eyes and being freed, however, he remained in the prison, not wanting to be a burden.

He is Sapmaster Vu's partner and accompanies Vu, Lya of Ten Songs and the adventurer during the Dread Wastes storyline to free Iyyokuk the Lucid and find/drink/brew more beer. Old Hat is a wizened Grummle wrestling coach who gives players advice for fighting The Wrestler during one of the August Celestials daily quests at the Temple of the White Tiger. He is reminiscent of the "wise, experienced trainer" character type from boxing and fighting films. He provides players access to his "Refreshing Bucket" for healing during the fight.

On Plagues, Curses, and Blights is a book written by Royal Historian Archesonus. The book's eighth chapter discusses an odd period history during which there was an increase in disease, famine, and violence, and a theory associating these events with a nameless horseman carrying a sword of sinister origin. Archesonus doubts the existence of such an individual, and argues that the legend of the horseman was simply a way for the people of the time to cope with phenomena beyond their control.
